{{Top|leg}}
The '''Leech Legion''' was a group of genetically-altered [[Lugubraa]]&mdash;known as [[blind berserker]]s&mdash;in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].

The [[Croke]], while engaging in a vicious [[Croke civil war|civil war]] among their own kind, introduced Lugubraa soldiers to their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworlds]] in the [[Croke Reach]]. The Lugubraa proved so tenacious and deadly that for over 300 [[Standard year/Legends|years]], they spread, destroying Croke settlements across the region, no longer under the control of their original employers. The Croke sought the help of the [[Cloning/Legends|cloners]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], believing that they needed to fight the Lugubraa with members of their own kind. The [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]] created a genetic variant. The Croke called this new force the "Leech Legion", but these clones proved to be just as deadly to the Croke as their predecessors.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref><ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>

At some point during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Leech Legions attacked the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Niorde]]. In an effort to protect their world, several [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] of the native [[Niordi]] traveled to a [[Niordi secret laboratory|secret laboratory]] and underwent a radical [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] alteration to become [[Niordi living weapon|living weapons]]. Several of those scouts perished during the experiment and before the survivors were operational, the Leech Legions had overrun Niorde. The remaining [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] artillery units attacked the enemy [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], and only [[D'harhan]], a Niordi living weapon, survived the confrontation.<ref name="TEGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
